title: InterfaceListPage hydrates a hollow view out of a personalization overlay row — a dependency on the fat write that #5233 removes for new rows
body:
Observation filed while shipping the write half of #5233 (PR #5772). **Not a
confirmed user-visible regression** — a coupling worth recording before someone
meets it as a mystery. Unassigned, `finding` only, not queued.

## The coupling, asserted by the codebase itself

`packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, in `narrowPersonalizationOverlay`'s
docblock, gives this as a reason the read-side narrowing is deliberately **not**
applied inside `listViewOverrides` / `getView`:

> those two answer with the stored DOCUMENT … and `InterfaceListPage` hydrates a
> hollow view out of that document.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx:288-315` is that consumer. When
the resolved source view comes up **hollow** (`hasColumns(resolvedView)` false — the
ADR-0017 expansion can serve a default-view item with an empty config), it fetches
the per-view row and merges it as `{ ...resolvedView, ...hydratedView }`.

## What #5233 changes about it

For a **saved** view that row is the view's own body and still carries `columns` —
untouched by #5233, whose saved-view branch is byte-identical to before.

For a **system** view that a user has personalized, the row is an overlay. Before
#5233 it happened to carry a *frozen copy* of the source view's `columns`, so
hydration succeeded with stale columns. After #5233 a newly written overlay carries
only the patch, `hasColumns(full)` is false, the `getView` fallback reads the same
thin row, and the page falls through to
`/* hollow view stays hollow — renderer falls back to defaults */`.

So for that one case the behaviour moves from **stale frozen columns** to **default
columns**. Arguably an improvement — the overlay was never a legitimate source of a
view body, and reading one as such is the "second de-facto contract" shape AGENTS
§0.1 warns about — but it is a behaviour change and nobody has decided it on purpose.

## What is NOT affected

- Rows already at rest: untouched until their next toolbar toggle.
- Saved views: unchanged.
- objectui's list switcher (`ObjectView`): unchanged — it merges through
  `sanitizeViewOverride`, which has narrowed overlays since PR #5272 regardless of
  what is stored.

## Reachability — measured only as far as it can be from here

The full `packages/app-shell` + `packages/data-objectstack` suites are green with
#5233's change in place (`Test Files 543 passed`, `Tests 5475 passed | 1 skipped`),
so nothing currently pinned exercises this path with a personalized system view.
That is evidence the case is **untested**, not evidence it is unreachable — it
needs a deployment whose view-list endpoint serves a hollow expansion item for a
view that also has an overlay row. Confirming or dismissing it wants a dogfood run,
not a unit test.

## Suggested disposition

Either pin the intended behaviour (hollow + overlay ⇒ defaults, deliberately), or
decide the hollow-view hydration should not consult overlay rows at all and read the
source through the path that owns view bodies. Both are outside #5233's fence, which
grants `ObjectView.tsx`, `ObjectView.*.test.*`, the one `data-objectstack` docblock
and `.changeset/*` — `InterfaceListPage.tsx` is not in it.
